source: All source founders and prior continuation outcomes are exposed. New namespace supplies fresh future randomness. Development only.

primary.endpoint: Mean original-rule success fraction at g16..33 across four packets per block, then across all 28 exposed acquisition blocks.
primary.criterion: Single paired acquisition-block contrast: ongoing current-success guard minus one successful rewrite then retain, under independent noise. Support iff nondegenerate one-sided95% t lower>0; contradiction iff nondegenerate one-sided95% upper<=0; otherwise unresolved. No optional stopping, sample extension, primary substitution or equivalence claim.
primary.inference: 28 exposed acquisition blocks are the uncertainty unit. Fresh future randomness; conditional exposed-panel development estimand. Packets, time points and arms are not independent replicates. Approximate paired t intervals.

sample_rationale: All 28 prior selected blocks; complete exposed panel, no outcome-selected subset. One-hour feasibility screen, not a power-qualified confirmatory sample.
user_runtime_preference: Aim for one hour; this study has a 3600-second detached-run hard cap. No automatic extension.
